text:
Ellen: ran a quick audit after customer reported odd decrypts on private cluster — looks like serviceaccount `sidecar-injector` in ns `analytics` called keystore key owned by `billing`
Raj: do we have proof of access path?
Ellen: yes — audit shows UNIX socket used from pod with hostPath mount `/var/run/redwood-keystore.sock`. timestamped decrypts at 2026-03-20T18:12:03Z
Talia: that implies hostPath or hostNetwork escape. any ClusterRoleBinding references?
Ellen: found a ClusterRoleBinding created by onboarding script that granted `edit` to `analytics:sidecar-injector` — looks mis-scoped
Ben: immediate containment: 1) revoke tokens for that SA, 2) remove the offending ClusterRoleBinding, 3) cordon nodes where hostPath mounts were present, 4) rotate impacted keys
Sophie: forensics note: preserve node filesystem and audit logs before rotation. commit a tarball of `/var/log/redwood-agent/audit.log` and upload to secure bucket with restricted ACLs
Raj: netpol to apply in analytics ns — default deny egress then only allow keystore-proxy svc. sample I tested: ```apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-lockdown-to-keystore
  namespace: analytics
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: redwood-keystore-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8443
```
Talia: gatekeeper constraint idea: deny ClusterRoleBinding where subject.namespace != bindingNamespace OR subject.name matches tenant-scoped SAs. short-term, add audit annotation for new CRBs
Ellen: also check daemonset mounts: `kubectl get ds -A -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.spec.template.spec.volumes[*].hostPath}{"\n"}{end}' | grep keystore`
Ben: tighten host socket perms on nodes: chown root:keystore /var/run/redwood-keystore.sock && chmod 0660 and run systemd droppriv guard to run proxy under keystore group only
Sophie: increase decrypt audit retention for this customer to 365d temporarily and enable an alert for namespace mismatch decrypts (rule: requesting_namespace != key_owner_namespace)
Raj: add admission webhook to reject Pod specs with hostPath that reference `/var/run/redwood-keystore*` in tenant namespaces. also prevent `hostNetwork: true` for non-admin tenants
Talia: assign owners: Ellen (triage + forensics), Raj (netpol + alerts), Ben (node hardening + key rotation), Sophie (audit retention + customer comms), I'll draft Gatekeeper constraint and policy-bot will gate new CRBs
policy-bot: Auto-note: Gatekeeper policy draft branch created: gk/restrict-crb-tenant-sa. CI checks queued
Ellen: filed incident INC-2031-PRIV-KEystore — customer notified that we're investigating, no confirmed exfil yet. will keep timeline updated
Ben: next checks: scan for any ExternalName services or DNS tunnelling routes that could leak egress, and enumerate projected tokens in pods `kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath="{.items[*].spec.serviceAccountName}" | sort | uniq -c`
Sophie: customer comms: concise template ready — "we detected anomalous access path, applied containment controls, preserving logs, rotating keys; will share findings after investigation"
Ellen: thanks team. once containment verified, we'll discuss longer-term agent redesign to avoid hostPath sockets entirely (mTLS service inside node instead).
